verdict.rationale: ClickHouse Cloud pricing docs say unused resources scale down to zero so you don't pay for idle services, and that compute and storage are billed separately and drop to zero when idle. That covers the core idle-to-zero behavior for prototypes. Storage is still billed under usage-based pricing, so an idle project costs little rather than literally nothing. Durability while idle is only implied by the separated storage, plus backups exportable to your own cloud account. Missing for 10: explicit statement that data persists durably across scale-to-zero, evidence of a truly $0 idle or free tier, resume/cold-start behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
